changeSet.sql: UPDATE cell_entry ce1 SET cell_entries_order = cell_entries_order - 1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM cell_entry ce2 JOIN table_column tc ON ce2.table_column_id = tc.id WHERE ce2.table_row_id = ce1.table_row_id AND tc.value_type = 'CENTRAL_FILE_ID' AND ce1.cell_entries_order > ce2.cell_entries_order );
DELETE FROM cell_entry ce WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM table_column tc WHERE ce.table_column_id = tc.id AND tc.value_type = 'CENTRAL_FILE_ID' );

UPDATE table_column tc1 SET table_columns_order = table_columns_order - 1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM table_column tc2 WHERE tc2.value_type = 'CENTRAL_FILE_ID' AND tc2.aggregation_result_id = tc1.aggregation_result_id AND tc1.table_columns_order > tc2.table_columns_order );
